vip-identification.label: VIP Identification
vip-identification.helpText: Configure how Community Voices identifies VIP users.

vipFlairs.label: VIP User Flairs
vipFlairs.helpText: Comma-separated list of flairs that trigger the bot (e.g., Pilot, Developer, Admin)

vipUsernames.label: VIP Usernames
vipUsernames.helpText: Comma-separated list of specific usernames to treat as VIPs (no u/ needed)

vipDescriptor.label: VIP Descriptor Text
vipDescriptor.helpText: Define how VIP users are described in your community. This is used in the header of pinned summary comments: 'There are X comments from [Descriptor] in this post'

vip-comments.label: VIP Comments
vip-comments.helpText: Configure how Community Voices handles comments made by VIP users.

pinnedSummary.label: Pinned Summary Comment
pinnedSummary.helpText: Enable to add a pinned comment summarizing all comments made by VIP users.

includeCommentReplies.label: Include Comment Replies?
includeCommentReplies.helpText: Enable to include replies to other comments when counting comments made by VIP users.

setFlairAfterCommenting.label: Update Post Flair on Comments?
setFlairAfterCommenting.helpText: Enable to automatically update the post flair after a VIP user comments.

vipCommentPostFlairText.label: Post Flair to Use
vipCommentPostFlairText.helpText: Enter the post flair to apply after a VIP user comments.

ignoreCommand.label: Ignore Command
ignoreCommand.helpText: If a VIP starts their comment with this command, the bot will skip it.

ignoredPostFlairs.label: Ignored Post Flairs
ignoredPostFlairs.helpText: Comma-separated list of post flairs to exclude. Exact, case-insensitive matches are required.

vip-posts.label: VIP Posts
vip-posts.helpText: Configure how Community Voices handles posts submitted by VIP users.

setFlairAfterPosting.label: Update Post Flair on VIP Posts?
setFlairAfterPosting.helpText: Enable to automatically update the post flair after a VIP user submits a post.

vipPostFlairText.label: Post Flair to Use
vipPostFlairText.helpText: Enter the post flair to apply after a VIP user submits a post.

autoStickyVipPosts.label: Auto-Sticky Posts Made by VIP Users?
